observations: Photo 0 shows a white and blue industrial steam generator with a chrome iron on top. The unit has two green toggle switches, a black handle, and a black knob. A black braided hose is connected to the iron. The front panel has 'MADE IN ITALY' and a CE mark. The iron has a dial and a red button. A watermark 'CHIMAObi GODSWILL' is visible.

Photo 1 shows the same unit from a slightly different angle. The brand 'Vaporino' is visible on a blue oval sticker with a lion logo. Below it, 'BATTISTELLA' is printed. The same controls and hose are visible. The same watermark is present.
The unit appears to be outdoors on a concrete surface. The iron is not plugged in. No visible damage or wear is apparent in the photos.

claims.claim: Original copper tank industrial steaming generator
claims.evidence: The photos show the exterior and controls, but the tank is not visible. No text or label confirms a copper tank. The seller's claim cannot be verified from the images.

claims.claim: suitable for your laundry, fashion designer, hotel...
claims.evidence: The item is an industrial steam generator with a heavy-duty iron, which is commonly used in commercial laundry, fashion design, and hotel settings. The design and branding (Vaporino, Battistella) are consistent with professional use.

risks.risk: The tank may not be made of copper as claimed
risks.proof: A photo showing the interior or side of the tank, or a label specifying material.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a standard steel tank unit, which is less valuable

risks.risk: The unit may not be functional or may have internal damage
risks.proof: A video showing the unit powered on, water filling, and steam output, or a close-up of the power cord and plug.

risks.risk: The iron may be damaged or not compatible with the generator
risks.proof: A close-up of the iron's soleplate and connection point, and a test video of steam output.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a non-functional iron or with reduced value

proof_requests: A photo or video showing the interior or side of the tank to verify material (copper vs. steel).
A video of the unit powered on, showing water filling and steam output.
A close-up of the iron's soleplate and connection point to check for damage or wear.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a Vaporino Battistella industrial steam generator, but key claims (copper tank) and functional status cannot be verified from the current photos. Hidden risks related to material and functionality affect pricing, so proof is needed before pricing.
